SR-001.justification: For every reference policy, the V3 profile minus its three no-report lines equals the V2 profile; V1/V2 and presets v1/v2 fixtures pass unchanged; presets v3 are pinned and equal v2 apart from the base; the macOS escape suite passes 23/23 on base V3 with reporting.

SR-002.justification: No quiet service name or path appears in any hard-deny or data-class rule of the full hard-deny policy, and V3 adds exactly three quiet lines from the fixed list (base::MACOS_V3_QUIET_SERVICES, dtracehelper, /dev/tty).

SR-003.justification: Every quiet deny precedes every allow in every reference profile; with Tty::Inherit the caged open of /dev/tty is not refused by the sandbox (ENXIO from the kernel, no EPERM). KF-M30 pins that a later allow overrides a no-report deny.

SR-004.justification: Violations differing in pid, process, operation, target or kind stay separate; equal ones merge and the count saturates at u32::MAX; past the cap a kept entry keeps counting and a new key is dropped. Caged tests show a repeated read as one entry (macOS) and a 20,000-call flood as one entry with 20,000 repeats (Linux T1/T2).
